verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at help.puzzle.io (HTTP 200) with a structured, markdown-linked index of help articles, and those articles are served as .md files. Separate evidence says puzzle.io's own llms.txt links to the ReadMe developer reference, which is synced from a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: no llms-full.txt or documented docs-wide markdown endpoint (the /en/.md probe returned 404), the OpenAPI spec is not prose-linked from the docs, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: it is the sync source for the vendor's ReadMe-hosted developer reference (puzzle-api.readme.io, linked from puzzle.io's llms.txt)
